rule: Two stages (Nov 15). Real money starts as a trial: 20+ counted copies in 15+ events at score 77.5+ (4 trial slots; a paper 80+ is still a trial). Full tier comes ONLY from real results (15+ real copies in 10+ events, profitable). Once on real money only real P&L decides: back to paper when real losses use up its budget ($1 at 77.5 up to $5 at 80+, set once by its paper score at admission; plus real profit banked). Paper is only the admissions test. A trial with no real copy for 48 h gives up its slot to the next in line (24 h wait to return). Paper grade: judged once it has 50+ counted (buyable, settled) copies in 30+ different events. Score = 80 + 2.5 x expected profit per copy (c/contract after fees): every trader starts at what copying earns on average (-1.9c now) and only its own counted copies move it, one credit per event, our real-money results counting double. Copied at 80+ (expected profit above 0) while its last 50 copies average better than -leeway (5c, +up to 5c for a high score); paused below that, back when it recovers. Size: 90+ = 2, 95+ (300 copies) = 3, only after 20+ real copies in profit
